text:
alex: Planning a soft-cycle (fan spindle + NIC microcode) for satellite racks in eu-west1 next Tue during low traffic. Rolling reboot across 10 racks, doing cohorts of 3 nodes each, ~2min drain per node. Need ops coverage, brief customer comms, and cost estimate.

maria: Which Dedicated pools and spot backfills live on those racks? Any batch jobs to shift?

jin: Suggestion: stagger by AZ, move low-priority spot jobs to on-demand for the window, pre-warm KV caches after each cohort. Autoscale burst to absorb ~20% hit. Cordon/drain commands I plan to use:

```
kubectl cordon <node>
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120 --timeout=10m
```

This should evict gracefully and free GPUs.

tess: I'll draft a short customer note + statuspage blurb. Flag SLOs we might hit; schedule post-maint sanity check. @maria can you own comms? :calendar:

ops-bot: Maintenance created: maintenance/1735510000 (runbook: https://internal.runbooks/rack-softcycle). Reminders scheduled +30m and +10m.

alex: Cost estimate: diverting 10% traffic to on-demand for 2h -> ~30 GPU-hrs (~$180). If autoscale bursts 20% -> ~60 GPU-hrs (~$360). Recommend $400 contingency.

maria: We should confirm which model-serving routes are pinned to these racks and temporarily avoid scheduling critical routes on cohort nodes.

jin: Will add ephemeral placement rule: route.priority=critical -> avoid labels rack=cohort-A until +1h post-restart. Revert with:

```
redwoodctl routing update --policy revert-to-default --selector "rack=cohort-A"
```

sre-oncall: Note: last night's eu-west1 latency spike suggests starting at 03:00 UTC instead of 02:00 to avoid backup overlap. If we keep earlier slot, reduce cohorts to 2 nodes.

alex: Updated: start 03:00 UTC, cohorts of 3. I'll update runbook and post checklist. @tess / @maria publish customer note and flip incident template to maintenance-mode. :thumbsup:

maria: I'll send note to product and include recovery ETA and enterprise support contact.

jin: I'll run a canary priming job 15m before each cohort to warm model/KV caches:

```
redwoodctl jobs run --job priming --payload '{"seed_prompts": ["<warmup>"]}' --region eu-west1
```

Tag metrics with maint_tag=softcycle-1735510000.

sre-oncall: I'll watch p99 and tail latency during first cohort; abort if p99 > 250ms for >3m and trigger fallback.

alex: Thanks, posting final window and checklist in #eng-infra and scheduling +30/+10 reminders.
